import json, resource, subprocess, sys, time
LIM = {'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
def job(policy):
    return json.dumps({'jobs':[{'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,
                                'events':[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':policy}]}]},separators=(',',':')).encode()
CASES = {
 'oversize10MB': job('match(A) allow;'*700000),
 'policy8MB': job('match(A) allow;'*660000),
 'gigantic_path': job('match(A'+',A'*1000000+') allow;'),
 'gigantic_parens': job('('*3000000),
 'gigantic_ws': job(' \t\n\r'*2000000),
 'many_rules': job('match(A) allow;'*200000),
 'json_nesting': b'{"jobs":['+'['*62+'0'+']'*62+'}]}',
 'normal': json.dumps({'jobs':[{'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,
     'events':[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'}]}]*2},separators=(',',':')).encode(),
}
name=sys.argv[1]
data=CASES[name]
start=time.time()
p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/launch.py','/workspace/project'],
    stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    env=dict(PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/workspace',LANG='C',TMPDIR='/workspace/tmp',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'),
    cwd='/workspace',close_fds=True)
out,err=p.communicate(data,timeout=170)
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('%-14s in=%9d cpu=%5.1fs wall=%5.1fs rss=%6.0fMB exit=%d out=%s'%(
    name,len(data),u.ru_utime+u.ru_stime,time.time()-start,u.ru_maxrss/1024,p.returncode,out[:48]))
PYEOF
for c in oversize10MB policy8MB gigantic_path gigantic_parens gigantic_ws many_rules normal; do timeout 300 python3 /workspace/tmp/dev/mem.py $c; done
